headline: Trilegal, Latham & Watkins, Goodwin act on Oxane Partners securing investment from TA Associates
sum: Oxane Partners has secured a strategic growth investment from TA Associates. Trilegal advised Oxane Partners and its shareholders on this transaction.
detail: Oxane Partners has secured a strategic growth investment from TA Associates. Trilegal advised Oxane Partners and its shareholders on this transaction. The transaction team was led by Abhishek Guha (Partner) and Tanya Uppal (Partner), with support from Yash Modi (Senior Associate) and Vishakha Dube (Associate). Due diligence was conducted by the transaction team, along with Vijay Chawla (Senior Associate) amd Simran Chetwani (Associate).
